slots.original: Goal: consistent wake time, 7:00 daily incl. weekends. Caffeine cutoff 2 pm. Screens off 30 minutes pre-bed — light exposure suppression of melatonin onset is the key lever here. Can't sleep after 20 min? Get up, low-light activity, retry. Morning sunlight 10 minutes → circadian anchor reinforcement. Expect 1–2 weeks adjustment.
